data.long_meaning: Meraviel is a Hebrew name meaning 'wonder of God' or 'wonderful sight of God'. Meraviel has a rich spiritual significance, representing the awe and reverence we should have for the Almighty God.

in_greek.name: Μεραβιέλ
in_greek.meaning: Το Μεραβιέλ σημαίνει φόβος του Θεού
in_greek.long_meaning: Το Μεραβιέλ είναι όνομα που σημαίνει φόβος του Θεού, προερχόμενο από τις ελληνικές ρίζες που συνδέονται με το θρησκευτικό αίσθημα της σεβασμού και της υπακοής προς τον Θεό. Στην πνευματική παράδοση, το όνομα αυτό μπορεί να συμβολίζει τη σχέση του ανθρώπου με το θείο.

historical_references.reference: Legend of St. Meriam, Meravella, or Meriel of Cornwall. In this legend, Meriadoc of Cornwall has a vision of the soul of a young girl who died in a shipwreck. He goes in search of her body and finds it washed ashore in Brittany. He brings it back to Cornwall and builds a church on the site where the shipwreck occurred. Meriam is believed to be the dedicatee of this church. The name Meriam is said to derive from the Cornish words 'myr' (sea) and 'iad' (lady).

The Vita Sancti Petri, an account of the life and miracles of St. Peter of Cornwall, mentions a certain Meriavel or Meriel. She is described as a 'maiden of great virtue' who was a servant of St. Petroc, another Cornish saint. Meriavel is said to have been visited by an angel in a vision, who instructed her to go to a nearby well to find a spring of water. When she reached the well, she found that the water had miraculously turned to wine. This miracle was seen as a sign of her holiness and devotion to God.

This character's bravery, wisdom, and beauty have inspired many to use the name for their own characters in tabletop gaming sessions. Meraviel is also a favorite name among cosplayers, who appreciate its unique and enchanting quality. The name can be found in print through various books, as well as in digital formats through online role-playing games and forums. Meraviel is also celebrated at real-life events, such as fantasy conventions and cosplay competitions, where fans gather to share their creativity and love for this captivating name.
